name: browser-verify
description: A vision model of the Convertigo LLM gateway (default mistral/mistral-large-4) drives the Studio browser of the conversation (the viewer opened by mobile-builder-open), walks the paths given in plain language, looks at its screenshots and returns a short report: each check passed or failed with evidence, the visual defects seen, the screenshots saved in the Studio workspace, and the usage of its model calls. It only observes and never edits the project. One call replaces a whole functional and visual browser proof. A call waits up to waitSec (50 s) for the report; a longer verification answers status running with a verificationId to collect the report with.

cdpEndpoint.description: Only when the agent host sends no viewer debug port: the loopback CDP endpoint of the Studio browser (browserDebugUrl of mobile-builder-open).

checks.description: Acceptance checks reported one by one (at most 20), for example: The list shows 3 posts with the status "À déclarer".

hints.description: Facts the sub-agent needs and cannot guess: demo accounts and passwords, expected values, what just changed.

maxSteps.description: Maximum model turns, 6 to 80; default 40, or 9 per path when that is more.

model.description: Vision model of the Convertigo LLM gateway.

paths.description: Paths to walk and check, in plain language, in order (at most 8). For example: sign in as the demo user, open a record, change a field and save it, then check that the list shows the new value.

reasoning.description: none is fast and cheap; high only for a hard case.

timeBudgetSec.description: Default 150, or 40 per path when that is more. The sub-agent reports what it has when it runs out.

url.description: Application URL to open first, usually viewerHomeUrl from mobile-builder-open. Empty: start from the page open in the viewer.

verificationId.description: To collect a running verification: the verificationId of a status running answer, alone (no paths). The call waits up to waitSec again.

viewport.description: Window of the verification: desktop (default, 1280x800), mobile (390x844) or <width>x<height>. The Studio viewer gets its own size back afterwards.

waitSec.description: Seconds this call waits for the report. A verification still running then answers status running with its verificationId; keep the default, it fits every agent host.
